scope: Independent final scoped read-only SDK repeat review against the corrected v6 draft. Read corrected owned close implementation, complete SDK contract fixtures, actual privately owned native callback fixture, SDK close body vs pristine pinned source, optional APEX binding, related owner/driver/transport/dispatch methods, packaging/provenance/license/explicit CI hooks. All 134 direct inventory hashes checked at both ends; this does not mean full 134-file semantic review or whole-HAR/program qualification.
result: clean within reviewed scope; original P2 unfinished synchronous callback repeat deadlock resolved

resolution.completed_receipt: Ready channel/result checked under state lock before dispatcher classification, so complete success/failure remains available from every goroutine.
resolution.unfinished_dispatcher: Exact dispatcher or unknown current/dispatcher identity returns explicit ErrHARCloseOwnershipUnproven without waiting, mutating result, replacing done or touching first entry.
resolution.ordinary_independent_repeat: Independent known-identity callers wait without a held state mutex and receive the complete retained result.
resolution.first_owner: CAS/body/reason winner and existing error-panic-Goexit publication remain intact; ordinary Close retains early nil.
resolution.tests: Deterministic synchronous OnClose/held-body test checks callback error, first success and retained complete result; unknown-dispatcher test checks fail-closed and later complete result. Actual Chromium/WebKit fixture checks one callback, non-nil incomplete callback result, first real scrubbed artifact/retirement, repeat complete nil, absent raw file and exact one target request.

private_native_cleanup.private_driver: Fixture calls playwright.Run into a private local pw rather than pool/getBrowserInstance. Only that pw.Stop is used; sync.Once prevents double caller Stop.
private_native_cleanup.physical_process: Traced Playwright.Stop -> connection.Stop -> transport.Close -> stdin Close plus exact exec.Cmd.Wait. Private driver stop precedes callback/owner cleanup, permitting failure recovery without stopping shared drivers.
private_native_cleanup.physical_callback_and_owner: CallbackDone closes only after actual repeat returns. Cleanup joins that callback before raw descriptors/reservation release, calls actual teardown and finish wait; stop or callback join failure returns before raw descriptor release. Successful first teardown demonstrates retired ownership and absent raw data.
private_native_cleanup.scope_limit: No generic forced shutdown or shared-driver cleanup added. No claim that SDK Stop alone exposes a full Go receive-loop join; native test separately joins its relevant callback and captured owner work.

checks: All 80 copied pristine SDK hashes match cached v0.6100.0 source manifest; only declared browser_context.go differs.
MIT license/copyright and upstream module/native/platform/version pins retained.
Close body below entry guard is pristine apart from reason write lock; once notification broadcasts channel close.
Optional binding never falls back to ordinary early-nil Close; unknown prior/server close remains protected.
Six Go Docker dependency stages copy local source subset before go mod download; .dockerignore includes it.
Root replacement reaches controller and desktop root module; dashboard empty module only bounds Go walk.
Dependency SDK contracts explicitly run in Makefile and main CI because root ./... omits dependency modules.
Both recording PR/main triggers include local SDK path, with matching trigger-count static regression.
Existing dispatcher identity helper is reused; no new unsafe/reflection or nested pump path.
limitations: SDK normal/race/native gate results are owned and retained by HAR agent; reviewer ran no tests/builds.
Candidate is the named provisional v6 draft; later source changes require exact repeat review.
Broader HAR filesystem/retirement paths and final integrated Go/dashboard/recording verification remain separate gates.
